input.prompt: Wide cinematic comic panel: a thick gold coin flipping in mid-air, seen at a three-quarter angle with its smooth blank face toward the viewer and its milled edge catching the light, a few curved gold motion streaks around it, placed in the LEFT third of the picture and filling about 75 percent of the picture's height. Below and behind it, a dark green circuit board with fine gold traces recedes and fades into a deep black void; the RIGHT two thirds of the picture is calm, almost empty dark board fading to black, with nothing in it. Painted American comic book art, same style and finish as the references: sharp clean black ink outlines, modelled 3D form, one warm golden key light from above, a green rim light on the left edge of the coin and a red rim light on its right edge, comic halftone dots only inside the shadows, palette black, dark green, red and gold. The coin face is completely smooth and blank. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no engravings, no markings.
